A.span: Of all sentient beings without exception,
A.explanation: Dangling phrase separated from "striving for their happiness"; hard to parse.

B.explanation: "all ... without exception" (sems can ma lus thams cad) is reduced to plain "beings".

A.explanation: "all" and "our" are not in the Tibetan.

D.explanation: Tibetan has "great fear"; "all around" and plural terrors are added.

A.span: Of falling a thousand yojanas Into a long-lasting precipice, what need to mention?
A.explanation: Syntax is garbled and hard to parse; the "of falling" phrase is left dangling.

C.span: Of falling a thousand yojanas On a long-lasting precipice, what need to mention?
C.explanation: Syntax is garbled and hard to parse; "On" misstates falling into the precipice.

A.explanation: dad pa is faith/devotion, not respect.

A.span: the Bhagavan Of a yoke drifting on the great ocean
A.explanation: Line order splits the subject from its verb; "the Bhagavan of a yoke" misparses.

C.explanation: Tibetan says "strive in samadhi", not mastering it.

A.explanation: log par ltung means fallen into wrong/lower states (animals etc.), not "ruin".

B.explanation: Commentaries mean animals and lower states; "wrong paths" suggests heterodox views.

C.explanation: byang chub sems is bodhicitta, not Bodhisattvas; second object of reliance is changed.

B.span: They say that these are agents of the self
B.explanation: Tibetan asks what link allows "this is its action"; the claim about agents is not there.

D.span: seen in the nature of the Protectors
D.explanation: Source: those seen as sentient beings are the Protectors; here beings are seen as Protectors, reversing the perception.
